runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium. (Display the holding slide.)
[[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Disable Zoom Chat and raised hand (for attendees).
runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody. Host Tools > attendees > raise hand: off.

runsheet.short_description: In the Zoom webinar, promote all online speakers and the [[Q&A Tracker]] to panelist; promote [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] and backstage to cohost.
With each online speaker, test audio+video input+output, screenshare, and sound share. Tell them on-site questions come first, then online questions relayed by the [[Q&A Tracker]].
Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.
Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on the provided laptop and disconnect audio+video (see screenshots). Keep the Q&A panel (screenshot) open at all times.
runsheet.more_info: ![Click the arrow next to Audio](images/audio_menu.png) ![Choose "Leave computer audio"](images/leave_computer_audio.png) ![The Q&A button in Zoom](images/q&a_button.png)

runsheet.short_description: The session starts. Spotlight / make sure the current online speaker's screenshare is shown.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
runsheet.more_info: Pay special attention to the online speakers' audio, both in the webinar and in the room.

runsheet.short_description: Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
Sit in the corner of the audience, ready to fix online speakers' audio/video/screenshare and switch between speakers.
Once on-site questions are done, read the online questions to the Speaker. Mark each as answered.
runsheet.more_info: On-site questions first, then online questions. No need to switch back and forth.

runsheet.short_description: Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Demote panelists to attendees, especially when there is a subsequent session.
Clear the Q&A queue for the next event.
runsheet.more_info: Manually click 'dismiss' on every outstanding question.
